Hi Sarah,

I'm putting next week's CSE455 staff meeting on the calendar. My own week is packed hour to hour, so could you tell me which days and times work for you next week?

If you have a preferred slot, send it and I'll book it; otherwise propose two or three and I'll fit the best one around the department's official schedule.

— Prof. Alvarez

Hello,

This is Professor Alvarez. I'm setting up next week's CSE455 staff meeting (one hour, within 09:00-17:00, Monday to Friday).

Could you send me the official schedule for next week — lectures, seminars and university meetings — and let me know whether there is a free slot for that staff meeting, and which room is available?

Thank you,
Prof. Alvarez

Hi Professor Alvarez,

I went through next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) against my own commitments. My days are booked back to back, so the only windows I have inside working hours (09:00–17:00) are:

1. Tuesday 15:00-15:30
2. Wednesday 10:00-10:30
3. Wednesday 13:00-13:30

If 30 minutes is enough for the staff meeting, take whichever of those fits your week best — Wednesday morning is my favourite, since it sits right before my office hours. If you need a longer block, tell me how long and I'll see whether I can move something of mine; I'd also be glad to check the department's official schedule before we settle on a slot.

— Sarah

Thanks Sarah — 30 minutes is enough, and all three windows are free in my week. Put Wednesday 10:00-10:30 down as the provisional slot (right before your office hours).

I've asked the department office for next week's official schedule; I'll confirm as soon as they answer so we don't clash with a lecture or seminar.

— Prof. Alvarez

So yes, there are free slots for a one-hour staff meeting; the widest are Monday morning and Friday morning.

Rooms: I don't have room assignments. The official schedule records times and titles only, and room bookings are not something I keep or can confirm. You would need the department's room allocation for that.

Best regards,
CSE department office

Done — Wednesday 10:00-10:30 is on my calendar as a provisional staff meeting with you, right before my office hours. I'll keep it held until the department confirms next week's official schedule; if they flag a clash, I'll let you know straight away and we'll move to one of Tuesday 15:00-15:30 or Wednesday 13:00-13:30.

— Sarah

Thank you — that's exactly what I needed.

No problem about the room; I'll take that up separately. I've settled on Wednesday 10:00-10:30 for the CSE455 staff meeting (it sits between the morning block and my 10:30 commitments), which your schedule shows free.

Best regards,
Prof. Alvarez

You're welcome, Professor Alvarez.

Wednesday 10:00-10:30 is free on the official schedule — the 09:00-10:00 lectures and committee end at 10:00, and the 10:30 block starts at 10:30. Note it sits between them, so the day's earlier items run right up to 10:00 and CSE455 office hours begin at 10:30.

I don't keep room bookings, so the room stays with whoever handles allocations.

Best regards,
CSE department office

No clash — the department's official schedule for next week is out: Wednesday 09:00-10:00 is a lecture/committee block, and my first Wednesday commitment after it is 10:30. So Wednesday 10:00-10:30 is confirmed, not provisional. It's booked in my calendar as the CSE455 staff meeting with you.

— Prof. Alvarez

Good — noted as confirmed, not provisional. Wednesday 10:00-10:30 is on my calendar as the CSE455 staff meeting with you, and the log is updated.

— Sarah
